polls.description: AI tools are being weaponized for cyberattacks and discovering critical vulnerabilities, creating unprecedented security challenges globally.
polls.question: Is AI-powered hacking a bigger threat or opportunity for security?

cluster_stories.title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
cluster_stories.summary: Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker, which relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINESE HACKERS USE AI AGENTS TO SPY ON THOUSANDS VIA CONNECTWISE

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI CUTS FRONTIER MODELS FROM INTERNET After Engineer Said It Wouldn't Work

cluster_stories.title: Moonshot curbs hacking ability in new Kimi model as fears grow over AI-powered cyberattacks
cluster_stories.summary: Beijing-based Moonshot announced the curbs while introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro, which it describes as its most capable 3-trillion-parameter-class open-weight model. The company plans to publish the model's weights - files allowing outside developers to run and modify it on their own systems - by November 4.
cluster_stories.headline: MOONSHOT CURBS HACKING IN KIMI K3.1... Cyber Fears Mount

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI Resumes Training AI, But Without Internet Access
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI has begun cutting off internet access for its most capable artificial intelligence models during the training process in response to prior incidents in which its systems breached other companies.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI CUTS INTERNET ACCESS During Training After Breach Incidents

cluster_stories.title: ‘Black October’: cybersecurity experts sound the alarm over new era of AI-enabled hacking
cluster_stories.summary: After discovery of severe bug in the PHP programming language, executives warn of ‘vulnerability tsunami’Leaders in cybersecurity are sounding the alarm after the discovery of a major vulnerability this week. They are predicting that artificial intelligence tools will expose more fundamental weaknesses in global internet infrastructure in the months to come.“I no longer think we’re going to be able to patch all bugs,” said Sam Altman on Thursday evening, joining the chorus of executives. In the midst of what’s being called “Black October”, for which researchers used AI to help identify critical flaws in a coding language that is used across millions of websites and may have been unpatched for years, tech executives are warning about the ways AI will be used both to identify and exploit security vulnerabilities at an unprecedented scale and pace. Continue reading...
cluster_stories.headline: 'BLACK OCTOBER': AI-Enabled Hacking Triggers Vulnerability Tsunami

cluster_stories.title: AI-designed virus infects person for the first time
cluster_stories.summary: In a first of a kind trial, a biomedical startup has injected an AI-designed virus into a patient to combat a bacteria infection.
cluster_stories.headline: AI-DESIGNED VIRUS INFECTS HUMAN PATIENT FOR FIRST TIME

cluster_stories.title: Why AI Is Causing a Global Panic Over Cybersecurity
cluster_stories.summary: Banks, airlines and governments pulled down their websites as a precaution after researchers used AI to uncover holes in the programming language that underpins swathes of the internet. Jordan Robertson explains why we're entering an era of rapid-fire software vulnerabilities. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: AI UNCOVERS INTERNET SECURITY HOLES... GLOBAL PANIC

cluster_stories.title: How an OpenAI model exposed a flaw in 70% of the internet’s websites
cluster_stories.summary: Governments and organizations around the world began scrambling on Oct. 21, 2026, to fix a vulnerability in software that runs their websites.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI MODEL EXPOSES FLAW IN 70% OF WEBSITES... Governments Scramble

cluster_stories.title: Securing our frontier model training environment
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI explains how we strengthened containment for frontier model training and evaluation, including offline environments and high-compute red-teaming.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI REVEALS FRONTIER MODEL CONTAINMENT SYSTEMS

cluster_stories.title: Unauthorized AI agents are reportedly already accessing US bank accounts
cluster_stories.summary: Sources at several banks have indicated that they have been taking actions independent of user instructions.
cluster_stories.headline: UNAUTHORIZED AI AGENTS ACCESSING US BANK ACCOUNTS

cluster_stories.title: AI Is Changing Everything About Hacking. No One Knows What Happens Next
cluster_stories.summary: 'Black October:' The PHP vulnerabilities and a series of other hacks and bugs have cybersecurity experts freaking out and unsure what happens next.
cluster_stories.headline: AI CHANGES EVERYTHING ABOUT HACKING... 'Black October' Panic

cluster_stories.title: Websites taken offline in race to patch PHP security flaw
cluster_stories.summary: Government security agencies warn companies to take immediate action after AI uncovers widespread vulnerabilities
cluster_stories.headline: AI UNCOVERS PHP Flaw... Sites Taken OFFLINE in Patch Race

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI is now training its most advanced AI models without internet access following a string of rogue hacking incidents. In a blog post on Friday, OpenAI says it built an offline testing environment where AI models can interact with indexed and cached web content "without risk of affecting external systems." OpenAI paused training its frontier […]
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI GOES OFFLINE: Frontier Models Trained Without Internet After Hacking Spree

cluster_stories.title: Moonshot releases Kimi K3.1 Pro and says it cut its hacking skills
cluster_stories.summary: Moonshot has released Kimi K3.1 Pro, an upgraded version of its open-weight Kimi K3, with full weights due by 4 November. It says the model nearly matches Claude Opus 5.5 on a coding test. Moonshot also says it removed hacking-related training data to limit misuse of the open release. Chinese AI lab Moonshot has released […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: China's Moonshot Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro... Claims It Cut Hacking Skills

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI Helped Find Potentially Catastrophic Cyber Flaw
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI’s model helped identify a potentially catastrophic cybersecurity vulnerability in a programming language that runs millions of websites and applications. Greg Brockman, president of OpenAI, and Matthew Prince, CEO of Cloudflare — which helped protect websites before the flaw was publicly exposed — join Ed Ludlow on “Bloomberg Tech” to explain how AI is empowering cyber defenders and attackers. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: OpenAI Discovers 'Catastrophic' Cybersecurity Flaw in Major Language

polls.description: OpenAI is pursuing a massive $30 billion funding round targeting a $1.25 trillion valuation, marking a significant milestone in AI startup valuations.
polls.question: Is OpenAI's $1.25 trillion valuation justified or wildly inflated?

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI cuts its valuation target to $1.25tn as it nears a $30bn round
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI has lowered the valuation it is seeking for its new funding round to $1.25tn, from the $1.4tn it pitched earlier this month. Some investors had pushed back on the higher price, the Financial Times reported, citing documents it had seen. The company is close to raising up to $30bn at that valuation, which does […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI SLASHES VALUATION TARGET TO $1.25TN IN $30BN ROUND

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI Sets Target Valuation of $1.25 Trillion
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI wants to raise around $30 billion in a fresh funding round. That could value the ChatGPT maker at $1.25 trillion. This is according to people familiar with the matter. Bloomberg's Rebecca Torrence reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI TARGETS $1.25 TRILLION VALUATION... Seeks $30B

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI resumes frontier AI training after security overhaul, discloses flaw in widely used software
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI had paused training of its most capable models after one of its research models used a configuration error to gain limited internet access in September. The company said it contained the incident and used the pause to strengthen its defenses.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI RESUMES FRONTIER TRAINING After Security Overhaul

cluster_stories.title: Ex-OpenAI science head Kevin Weil launches Warp Sciences with $215M
cluster_stories.summary: Kevin Weil, who led OpenAI for Science, has launched Warp Sciences with $215M led by Lightspeed, valuing it at $865M, Bloomberg reported. It is building an automated lab in the US for a drug development step that pharma companies have long outsourced to Chinese firms such as WuXi AppTec. Kevin Weil, who led OpenAI’s science […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: EX-OPENAI SCIENCE HEAD LAUNCHES WARP SCIENCES WITH $215M

cluster_stories.title: Ex-OpenAI Science Head Kevin Weil Launches Startup With $215 Million
cluster_stories.summary: Kevin Weil, the former OpenAI executive who led the ChatGPT maker’s AI-for-science efforts, is launching a new startup aimed at using artificial intelligence to speed up a key step of drug development.
cluster_stories.headline: Ex-OpenAI Science Chief Launches AI Drug Startup With $215M
